name: Sakashita Keiji
source:
The father of the director of the basketball club, [url=/c588]Chiaki[/url]. [spoiler]6 years ago, at the time when the bus fall accident occurred, he was a representative director of a IT related company but now he becomes unemployed after the company was rearranged.[/spoiler] He has some hunting experiences and can use sporting gun well.
